llc.formation_notes: Statutory fee, same figure for domestic and foreign registration in 11 V.S.A. § 4012. No publication requirement.

annual_report.name: Annual Report (domestic LLC)
annual_report.due: within three months after the end of the LLC's fiscal year (March 31 for a calendar-year LLC)

state_tax_on_llc.name: Vermont minimum business entity tax (Form BI-471 / BI-476)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: every S corporation, partnership and multi-member LLC (or LLC taxed as partnership/S corp) engaged in activities in Vermont
state_tax_on_llc.notes: A single-member LLC disregarded for federal purposes (Schedule C) is not required to file BI-471, so it does not owe the $250. Foreign LLC annual report is $170.

sources.title: 11 V.S.A. § 4012. Fees
sources.quote: (1) Articles of organization $155.00 ... (15) Annual report of a domestic limited liability company $45.00

sources.title: Vermont Department of Taxes, Business Entity Income Tax
sources.quote: Most business entities will file form BI-471, Business Income Tax Return. Generally, a minimum tax of $250 is due.

sources.title: 2025 Form BI-471 Instructions
sources.quote: Single member LLCs which have elected to be classified for federal purposes as disregarded entities ... are not required to file Form BI-471.

sources.title: 11 V.S.A. § 4033. Annual report for Secretary of State
sources.quote: The annual report shall be delivered to the Secretary of State within three months after the expiration of the company's fiscal year.

entity_level_taxes.name: Minimum entity tax (BI-471)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Pass-through treatment; entity pays the $250 minimum plus required estimated payments for nonresident shareholders at 6.6%. Built-in gains etc. taxed at corporate rate.

sources.title: 2025 Form BI-471 Instructions
sources.quote: The pass-through entity is liable for the minimum annual (entity) tax of $250 for each taxable year beginning on or after Jan. 1, 1998.

personal_exemption.notes: 2025 figure: $5,300 per exemption (deduction). 2026 withholding tables use a $450 monthly allowance ($5,400/yr), which suggests $5,400 for 2026 but the 2026 return figure is not yet published.

income_tax_2026.starting_point: federal AGI (Vermont own standard deduction and exemptions)
income_tax_2026.surtaxes: Minimum tax: if AGI exceeds $150,000, Vermont tax is the greater of 3% of AGI (less US-obligation interest) or the rate-schedule tax (2025 instructions).

sources.title: 2025 Form IN-111 Instructions
sources.quote: For Adjusted Gross Incomes (IN-111, Line 1) exceeding $150,000, Line 8 is the greater of 1) 3% of Adjusted Gross Income

sources.title: Vermont Percentage Method Withholding Tables (for wages paid in 2026)

estimated_tax.required_if: owe more than $500 after withholding (pay 100% of prior-year or 90% of current-year tax)
estimated_tax.notes: Form IN-114. Pass-through entities pay estimates for nonresident owners on WH-435.

unemployment_2026.notes: Wage base up from $14,800 in 2025. New-employer rate (commonly cited 1%) not confirmed on an official page.

notable: Multi-member LLCs and S corps owe a $250 minimum entity tax every year, but a single-member disregarded LLC does not (https://tax.vermont.gov/sites/tax/files/documents/BI-471-Instr-2025.pdf)
LLC annual report is $45 for domestic and $170 for foreign LLCs (https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/section/11/025/04012)
High earners (AGI over $150,000) pay at least 3% of AGI (https://tax.vermont.gov/sites/tax/files/documents/IN-111-Instr-2025.pdf)
No local income tax in Vermont; no elective pass-through entity tax found in BI-471 instructions
uncertain: 2026 income tax brackets, standard deduction and personal exemption are not yet published (the 2026 return instructions come out in early 2027); figures are tax year 2025 from the IN-111 instructions. Vermont indexes them annually.
Online LLC formation fee: statute says $155; a reduced online fee claimed by some third parties was not verified on sos.vermont.gov (fee page returned 404).
Annual report late penalty not verified.
UI new-employer rate not found on labor.vermont.gov.
No Vermont PTET found; absence not confirmed by a statute search.
